# Mute Tab (toggle_tab_mute): a muted tab goes on showing what it does —
# its badge, its row, a speaker struck through beside its name — but its
# bell, the notifications it asks for (OSC 9) and its program's states
# (OSC 7501) make no sound, post no banner, don't bounce the Dock icon and
# aren't counted on the Dock's badge; Activity keeps them, already read.
# tests/run.sh gives it a config where the bell sounds and bounces and
# waiting plays Ping. (A probe's app is never active: every pane counts as
# out of sight.) `msg=aGVsZA==` is "held" in base64.
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:quiet
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-tab:quiet
expect-muted:0
action:toggle_tab_mute
wait:0.3
expect-muted:1:quiet
expect-tab:muted
# (Its glyph is named for VoiceOver, not read as an image.)
expect-unlabeled:0 muted tab
type:printf '\a'; sleep 0.5; printf '\033]9;hello\a'; sleep 0.5; printf '\033]7501;state=blocked:app=probe:msg=aGVsZA==\a'; sleep 4
key:enter
wait:2.5
expect-status:tab=blocked dock=0 inbox=2 unread=0 posted=0 sounds= bounces=0
expect-activity:Waiting for you (1)|  sleep — held
shot:tab-mute.png
wait:3.0
# The same from a tab that isn't muted: heard, posted, counted.
tab:new
wait:0.5
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:loud
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-muted:1:quiet
type:printf '\a'; sleep 0.5; printf '\033]9;hello\a'; sleep 0.5; printf '\033]7501;state=blocked:app=probe:msg=aGVsZA==\a'; sleep 4
key:enter
wait:2.5
expect-status:tab=blocked dock=1 inbox=4 unread=2 posted=2 sounds=bell,Ping bounces=1
wait:3.0
# Muted from the palette while it waits for you: off the Dock's count at
# once; unmuted, back on it. The palette says what it would do now.
type:printf '\033]7501;state=blocked:app=probe:msg=aGVsZA==\a'; sleep 8
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-status:tab=blocked dock=1
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:mute tab
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Mute Tab
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-muted:2
expect-status:tab=blocked dock=0
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:mute tab
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Unmute Tab
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-muted:1:quiet
expect-status:tab=blocked dock=1
wait:7.0
# Muted it stays, moved to a window of its own and back, and saved with the window.
tab:1
action:move_tab_to_new_window
expect-windows:2
expect-other:muted
take-tab:1
wait:0.5
expect-windows:1
expect-muted:1:quiet
roundtrip:go
# The tabs along the top show it too.
action:set_setting:tab-bar=top
wait:2.0
expect-strip:quiet
expect-muted:1:quiet
shot:tab-mute-strip.png
# Back to the sidebar (the config as it was, for a run again).
action:reset_setting:tab-bar
wait:2.0
expect-muted:1:quiet
